# Environment Setup

Set these in your own environment (do not commit real values):

    OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
    AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAEXAMPLE0000000000
    GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your-token-here-0000000000000000000

These are placeholders — replace them with your real keys locally.
